_comment: Specific per-occurrence acts for recurring series whose generic title hides the real act/movie (e.g. 'Movie Mondays' → the actual film, 'Augment Summer Music Series' → the band). These render as single-day cards on the EVENTS-PAGE 'Daily Events' view (events.html fetches this file). The matching generic series is suppressed from the 'Recurring Events' calendar (SUPPRESS list in events.html). Maintained by the weekly 'recurring-acts-review' scheduled task: it re-reads each series' detail page, refreshes upcoming acts, and finds a poster/band photo (else leaves image blank → series logo/fallback). Dates beyond the events page's 60-day window simply don't render yet. Fields: series, date (YYYY-MM-DD), title, time, location, town(optional), description, link, image(optional), source.
